scope: Offline source/contract/entry review only. No native execution, build, GPU, workload qualification, A/A, A/B or performance sample performed by reviewer.

finding_history.defect: After Popen, affinity or save failure recorded LAUNCH_FAIL but did not stop its still-running owned runner/descendants; the declared one-attempt failure stop could be bypassed.
finding_history.fix: Keep child=None before launch. On exception, record owned PID; if still live, taskkill /PID child.pid /T /F and retain cleanup exit/stdout/stderr, kill parent if necessary, wait and record exit, then retain LAUNCH_FAIL and rethrow. No restart.
finding_history.verification: Read actual final source; cleanup success is not claimed tested. No new remaining correctness MUST found in the bounded entry review.

checks.facts: Exact JSON delta is only /id, /claim, /extensions/runner/validators (old validator filename replaced). All work, strata, data, ownership/completion/retirement, cold/warm boundaries, estimator, n15->31, 5%/10%, controls and build fields are unchanged. Eight actual compile inputs are byte-equal to fixed 35ec commit. Original runner builds only three declared adapter TUs with --parallel 2; no product/facade/native rebuild.

Launcher sets ordinary DISABLE_VULKAN_OBS_CAPTURE=1 before original runner startup. Original command validators inherit that environment; _child_environment keeps this nonblocked, non-HYLE-prefix, noncontrolled name for formal product/control children. Private verify/A/A additionally set it explicitly. No public environment policy change or additional overlay exclusion. CUDA/NVTX injection variables are refused.

checks.item: Verify, all qualification phases and ready ordering
checks.facts: Ready starts FAIL before auth/environment checks. One verify must exit0 with exact four workload snapshot labels, a Vulkan loader per phase, no known OBS path/basename, four before and four after full-oracle markers and eight successful destroy markers. Only then are baseline/candidate x execution-order x allocation-order (8 processes) run. Original factor median 5% and individual gross 10% rules remain. Only successful original A/A plus host recheck writes ready PASS; failures retain FAIL and existing no-repeat policy.

The retained-PASS branch rebinds identical identity and hashes all nine qualification logs, rechecks those logs and every output/raw/n-*/product-*.log, and records host FAIL on exception. Initial pre-sampling host record can correctly contain zero product logs; original collector subsequently creates/attests required products and post-validator checks them before overall qualification. Snapshot checks are outside timed regions. No claim of continuous module tracing.

Fixed build/output must not exist. Launcher demands clean private source and exact clean original peer; auth binds build/output and file hashes. New validator retains R18 authorization, actual .text, original instrument/source/SDK/resource identities and G09_BASE/peer root/cache/three-TU commands. Same-PID time extensions do not restart qualification. New auth and new clean private commit are not yet present in the reviewed snapshot, so neither is signed as satisfied.

before_execution: Seal obs-host-authorization.json over the actual final launcher, new validator/contract, current manifest/hook/OBS metadata, R21/R22 and immutable R18/old contract/old validator identities as declared; bind the fixed paths.
Commit only the new private inputs and authorization into a clean private Git revision. The present new files are untracked, so current entry intentionally cannot launch.

Retain every prior failed attempt. Execute at most the card-frozen fresh verify and 8 A/A; only actual PASS permits the original n15->31/P1. Any identity/no-OBS/oracle/retirement/A/A failure stops this attempt; no other overlay exploration or same-configuration retry.
limits: Actual host normalization, native verify/exit, A/A readiness, formal observations, controls and performance verdict remain NOT_RUN by this review; static synthetic checks are not native qualification.
The four existing snapshots are pre-timing point observations, not continuous absence of injection and not proof that OBS caused the historical bias. nvspcap may remain; no all-capture-free claim.
Current manifest/hook identities are current observations only, not historical DLL/source identity. R21 facts.scope typo32 is retained; actual count is36=4profiles x9logs.
This supports only Windows Vulkan host normalization. No Air result, product performance defect, G10 change, product owner reopening, statistical relaxation or new framework is authorized.
